text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting some work finished in my<n>office on a
day off, when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower walks up to me in a<n>costume and
suddenly bites my arm!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-um! Now you're... Vampire Rice's<n>familiar!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-um! Now you're... Vampire Rice's<n>familiar!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Now you have to stay by my side... So<n>stop working
and come with me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower brings me to an<n>amusement park for a
Halloween<n>event.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I get to go in for free since I'm<n>wearing a
costume.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Want to ride a roller-coaster, Big<n>Brother? Or maybe
the teacups?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Want to ride a roller-coaster, Big<n>Sister? Or maybe
the teacups?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, there's honey pumpkin popcorn!<n>Stay right
here, I'll go buy some!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-no! It's okay. You don't have to do<n>anything
today, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-no! It's okay. You don't have to do<n>anything
today, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look over there! What a long line...<n>That ride
must be pretty popular.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower points toward a long and<n>winding line
leading to the entrance of<n>a haunted house.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
L-let's do it, Big Brother! We're<n>already here, and it
seems popular,<n>so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
L-let's do it, Big Sister! We're<n>already here, and it
seems popular,<n>so...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Rice Shower is just<n>putting on a brave
face, but we get<n>into line all the same...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It sure is d-d-dark, huh? A-are you all<n>right, B-Big
Brother?
choice_data_list: I'm fine, but are you sure you're okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It sure is d-d-dark, huh? A-are you all<n>right, B-Big
Sister?
choice_data_list: I'm fine, but are you sure you're okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm fine too! After all, today is—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Creeeaaak...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyah! What was that?!

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Oooooh... Aaaaah! Graaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: EEEEK! W-we're surrounded!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I step forward to protect Rice Shower,<n>who's
trembling with fright, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no! I said I was going to take care<n>of you today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no! I said I was going to take care<n>of you today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You takes care of me every day! So...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You takes care of me every day! So...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Today... At least for one day... I want<n>you to rest and
have fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Today... At least for one day... I want<n>you to rest and
have fun!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly understand why she<n>brought me here.
She must have seen<n>me working on my day off and
wanted to show her appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, how do I respond to<n>her?
choice_data_list: Leave this to your familiar, Master!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, how do I respond to<n>her?
choice_data_list: Leave this to your familiar, Master!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Familiar? Oh, right, since I bit you<n>earlier...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I make it out of the haunted house,<n>protecting Rice
Shower the whole<n>way.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I was supposed to be the<n>one taking
care of you today...
choice_data_list: Don't worry. I had plenty of fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Big Brother? I want you to stay<n>by my side for
a long time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Big Sister? I want you to stay by<n>my side for a
long time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, please don't push yourself too<n>much... You
have to take breaks...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Or else I'll come and bite you again...<n>Just kidding,
hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower did her best to entertain<n>me for the
day, so I promise her I<n>won't work too hard.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right! I'm a vampire now, after all!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-and this vampire... is scarier than<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I, um, I'll suck your blood! O-or maybe<n>turn into
smoke and sneak up on you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-and... If you look me in the eye,<n>you'll turn to
stone! Or maybe I'll<n>curse you! Either way, I'm a
very,<n>very scary vampire!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hiss!

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Oooh, aaah... Sooo... scary...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look! The monsters left!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-now's our chance, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-now's our chance, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant... My heart is pounding...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um, were you scared, Big Brother? I<n>really hope
you had fun...
choice_data_list: Thanks to a certain scary vampire, I did.
Thanks to a certain scary vampire, I did.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um, were you scared, Big Sister? I<n>really hope
you had fun...
choice_data_list: Thanks to a certain scary vampire, I did.
Thanks to a certain scary vampire, I did.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, yay!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She looks a bit embarrassed, but Rice<n>Shower
smiles happily.
